bibliographic.title: Get Out!
bibliographic.author: DrGobblesMD
bibliographic.description:
You wake up in a basement with your head spinning. With a foggy mind you try to recall last night's events.
You look around the basement and you see bottles everywhere.
You went to a party.
You must have blacked out at the party.
You glance down at your watch.

07:45.

Oh no! Kyle's parents are going to be home any minute!!

You need to...

Get Out!
